AF_XDP net tile for TX/RX routing, GRE handling, stats, and socket setup.

# Purpose
This file implements the `net` tile, which translates traffic between AF_XDP sockets and Firedancer internal links. It sets up XDP and XSK socket state, manages UMEM frame pools, and connects the tile to route tables, neighbor tables, and the net device table. The tile handles both receive and transmit paths, including packet classification, routing, neighbor resolution, and optional GRE encapsulation.

The code also manages runtime work for the tile. It polls XDP statistics, updates metrics, wakes the kernel for RX and TX when needed, and returns completed TX frames to the free list. Incoming UDP packets are routed to downstream application tiles such as `quic`, `shred`, `gossvf`, `repair`, and `send`, while outgoing packets are selected by destination IP and sent through the correct XSK. The file also defines tile initialization, seccomp and file descriptor allow lists, and the `fd_tile_net` tile descriptor used by the Firedancer topology system.
